item.text:
The example compares **upgrade 12—attic insulation for unfinished attics—against baseline upgrade 0**, using **single-family detached buildings**.

Its summer zoom covers **July 8–15, 2018**: the code selects timestamps from `2018-07-08 00:15:00` through `2018-07-16 00:00:00` (EST), with each timestamp representing the preceding 15 minutes. [Source: ResStock timeseries notebook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/ResStock.github.io/696c020d696137830ddae75abbfb477ae7af8eaa/docs/resources/how-to-guides/access_timeseries_data_programmatically.ipynb).
